about: Read-only evaluation questions with known answers, run against the in-memory fake Snap used by the tests (test/helpers/harness.js sampleWorld). Each question names the tool an assistant should pick, its arguments, and what the answer must contain. Paths are dot paths over the JSON the tool returns; [n] picks an array item and length is an array's size.

questions.q: How many campaigns does the ad account have?
Which campaigns are running right now?
How many ad squads in campaign c2 are active?
What is the daily budget of the ad squad called Squad s4?
Which ads are in ad squad s1?
Which product catalog does the organization have?
Which product sets are in catalog cat1?
